gui.djbooth.booth: BOOTH MONITOR: level for whoever is stood at the booth
gui.djbooth.guide1: Type a song or paste a link, press Enter
gui.djbooth.guide2: Drag or scroll any knob · shift = fine · double-click = reset · hover = value
gui.djbooth.hotcue: Hot cue %s: click sets or jumps
gui.djbooth.eq_hi: HI EQ: -26 dB (kill with ISO) .. +6 dB. Double-click = flat
gui.djbooth.eq_mid: MID EQ: -26 dB (kill with ISO) .. +6 dB. Double-click = flat
gui.djbooth.eq_low: LOW EQ: -26 dB (kill with ISO) .. +6 dB. Double-click = flat
gui.djbooth.filter: COLOR filter (left = low-pass, right = high-pass, double-click = off)
gui.djbooth.echo: Echo FX (drag up for more; double-click = off)
gui.djbooth.eq_curve: EQ CURVE: ISO kills the band, EQ cuts to -26 dB
gui.djbooth.fader_curve: CH FADER curve: SLOW / LIN / SHARP
gui.djbooth.tap: Tap on the beat to measure BPM
gui.djbooth.xf_assign: CROSS FADER ASSIGN: A / THRU (off the crossfader) / B
gui.djbooth.color_param: PARAMETER: how strong the SOUND COLOR FX is
gui.djbooth.color.space: SPACE: reverb. Left adds it to the low/mid, right to the mid/high
gui.djbooth.color.dub_echo: DUB ECHO: echo repeats. Left keeps them mid-range, right extends them up
gui.djbooth.color.sweep: SWEEP: left gates the sound tighter, right narrows a band-pass
gui.djbooth.color.noise: NOISE: white noise through a filter. Left lowers its cutoff, right raises it
gui.djbooth.color.crush: CRUSH: left drives it into distortion, right crushes then high-passes
gui.djbooth.color.filter: FILTER: left sweeps a low-pass down, right sweeps a high-pass up
gui.djbooth.beatfx.delay: DELAY: one repeat, one beat fraction behind the original
gui.djbooth.beatfx.echo: ECHO: repeats that fade out, for trailing off a track
gui.djbooth.beatfx.ping_pong: PING PONG: the repeats bounce between left and right
gui.djbooth.beatfx.spiral: SPIRAL: reverb-like repeats that drift in pitch as they decay
gui.djbooth.beatfx.reverb: REVERB: adds a room around the sound. DEPTH sets how much
gui.djbooth.beatfx.trans: TRANS: chops the sound on and off on the beat. DEPTH sets the gap
gui.djbooth.beatfx.filter: FILTER: the cutoff sweeps up and down once per beat fraction
gui.djbooth.beatfx.flanger: FLANGER: one flange sweep per beat fraction, that jet-plane whoosh
gui.djbooth.beatfx.phaser: PHASER: sweeping notches, softer and more swirly than a flanger
gui.djbooth.beatfx.pitch: PITCH: shifts the pitch. DEPTH sets how far
gui.djbooth.beatfx.slip_roll: SLIP ROLL: loops the last slice; the track keeps running underneath
gui.djbooth.beatfx.roll: ROLL: loops the last slice of audio over and over
gui.djbooth.beatfx.vinyl_brake: VINYL BRAKE: slows to a stop like killing a turntable's motor
gui.djbooth.beatfx.helix: HELIX: loops a slice and keeps piling new sound on top of it
gui.djbooth.beat_fraction: Beat fraction the effect is timed to
gui.djbooth.fx_freq: FX FREQUENCY: which bands the effect is applied to
gui.djbooth.fx_channel: Which channel the BEAT FX runs on (MASTER = both)
gui.djbooth.fx_depth: LEVEL/DEPTH: how much of the effect you hear
gui.djbooth.fx_tap: TAP on the beat to set the BPM the effect is timed to
gui.djbooth.fx_onoff: Switch the BEAT FX in and out
gui.djbooth.cue_channel: CUE: preview this channel for the person at the booth only
gui.djbooth.xfader_curve: CROSS FADER curve: SLOW / LIN / SHARP
